title: KUROKO'S BASKETBALL MEN'S BLACK TEE T SHIRT Women’s M - TADATOSHI FUJIMAKI
descriptionText:
Purchased at LA Anime Expo. Women’s medium. 

Show off your love for basketball with this Kuroko's Basketball T-Shirt. Featuring a sleek black design, this tee is perfect for any fan of the sport. Made for both men and women, this shirt is available in size M and is crafted from high-quality materials for a comfortable fit.

The shirt is a must-have for any fan of the Kuroko's Basketball anime and manga series. It features the iconic Kuroko character and is perfect for casual wear or for attending games. Add this shirt to your collection today and show off your love for basketball in style.
